articles.title: Subject matter
articles.requirement: Establishes rules on the institutional framework for AML/CFT including FIUs, supervisors, beneficial ownership registers, risk assessment, and cooperation mechanisms

articles.title: Definitions
articles.requirement: Defines key terms complementing AMLR definitions: supervisory authority, FIU, competent authority, self-regulatory body, and other institutional terms

articles.title: Identification of exposed sectors at national level
articles.section: National measures in sectors exposed to ML/TF
articles.requirement: Member States must identify sectors and activities exposed to ML/TF risks at national level, including non-obliged-entity sectors

articles.title: Requirements relating to certain service providers
articles.section: National measures in sectors exposed to ML/TF
articles.requirement: Member States may impose AML/CFT requirements on certain service providers not covered by the AMLR where ML/TF risks are identified

articles.title: Requirements relating to the granting of residence rights in exchange for investment
articles.section: National measures in sectors exposed to ML/TF
articles.requirement: Member States operating golden visa/residence-by-investment schemes must apply enhanced ML/TF safeguards and due diligence

articles.title: Checks on the senior management and beneficial owners of certain obliged entities
articles.section: National measures in sectors exposed to ML/TF
articles.requirement: Member States must ensure fit and proper checks on senior management and beneficial owners of certain obliged entities to prevent criminal infiltration

articles.title: Risk assessment at Union level
articles.requirement: Commission conducts Union-level ML/TF risk assessment, identifying cross-border risks, vulnerabilities, and threats; consults AMLA and Member States

articles.title: National risk assessment
articles.requirement: Member States must carry out national risk assessment covering all ML/TF risks; keep current; make results available to obliged entities and supervisors

articles.title: Statistics
articles.requirement: Member States must maintain comprehensive AML/CFT statistics: STRs filed, investigations, prosecutions, convictions, assets frozen/confiscated, supervision activities

articles.title: Central beneficial ownership registers
articles.requirement: Member States must establish central registers of beneficial ownership information for corporate and other legal entities incorporated in their territory

articles.title: General rules regarding access by competent authorities, self-regulatory bodies and obliged entities
articles.requirement: Competent authorities, FIUs, self-regulatory bodies, and obliged entities performing CDD must have access to BO registers without restriction

articles.title: Specific access rules for persons with legitimate interest
articles.requirement: Persons with legitimate interest (journalists, civil society, researchers) may access certain BO information subject to conditions

articles.title: Procedure for verification and mutual recognition of legitimate interest
articles.requirement: Establishes procedure for verifying legitimate interest claims; mutual recognition of legitimate interest status across Member States

articles.title: Templates and procedures
articles.requirement: Commission adopts implementing acts specifying templates and procedures for BO information submission and access

articles.title: Exceptions to the access rules
articles.requirement: Limited exceptions to BO register access where disclosure would expose the beneficial owner to disproportionate risk of fraud, kidnapping, or similar threats

articles.title: Bank account registers and electronic data retrieval systems
articles.requirement: Member States must establish centralised bank account registries or electronic data retrieval systems enabling identification of account holders by FIUs and authorities

articles.title: Implementing acts for the interconnection of registers
articles.requirement: Commission adopts implementing acts for interconnection of bank account registers across Member States via a single access point

articles.title: Single access point to real estate information
articles.section: Single access point to real estate information
articles.requirement: Member States must ensure competent authorities have access to real estate ownership information through a single access point

articles.title: Establishment of the FIU
articles.requirement: Each Member State must establish a single FIU as national centre for receiving, analysing, and disseminating STRs and other ML/TF-relevant information; operationally independent

articles.title: Fundamental Rights Officer
articles.requirement: Each FIU must appoint a Fundamental Rights Officer to ensure FIU activities respect fundamental rights, particularly data protection and privacy

articles.title: Access to information
articles.requirement: FIUs must have direct or indirect access to financial, administrative, and law enforcement information necessary for their functions including BO registers and tax databases

articles.title: Responses to requests for information
articles.requirement: Obliged entities must respond to FIU requests for information promptly and fully; FIU may set deadlines for responses

articles.title: Provision of information to supervisors
articles.requirement: FIUs must provide relevant information to supervisory authorities where ML/TF concerns are identified during analysis

articles.title: Suspension or withholding of consent
articles.requirement: FIUs must have the power to suspend or withhold consent to a transaction for a limited period to analyse and assess ML/TF suspicion

articles.title: Instructions to monitor transactions or activities
articles.requirement: FIUs may instruct obliged entities to monitor specific transactions or activities of a customer for a defined period

articles.title: Alerts to obliged entities
articles.requirement: FIUs may issue alerts to obliged entities regarding ML/TF typologies, trends, and specific risks requiring enhanced vigilance

articles.title: FIU annual report
articles.requirement: FIUs must publish an annual report on activities including statistics on STRs received, analyses conducted, and disseminations made

articles.title: Feedback by FIU
articles.requirement: FIUs must provide timely and adequate feedback to obliged entities on STR quality and usefulness, including typologies and sanitised case studies

articles.title: Cooperation between FIUs
articles.requirement: FIUs must cooperate with each other exchanging information spontaneously or upon request using FIU.net or successor secure communication system

articles.title: Protected channels of communication
articles.requirement: FIU-to-FIU communication must use protected channels ensuring confidentiality and integrity of exchanged information

articles.title: Exchange of information between FIUs
articles.requirement: Detailed rules on information exchange between FIUs: scope of data, timelines, conditions, and restrictions on further dissemination

articles.title: Joint analyses
articles.requirement: FIUs may conduct joint analyses of cross-border cases supported by AMLA with common dissemination rules and protections

articles.title: Use by FIUs of information exchanged between them
articles.requirement: Information received from another FIU may only be used for the purpose for which it was requested or spontaneously provided

articles.title: Consent to further dissemination of information exchanged between FIUs
articles.requirement: Further dissemination of information received from another FIU requires prior consent of the originating FIU

articles.title: Effect of criminal law provisions
articles.requirement: Criminal law provisions in Member States must not impede FIU-to-FIU information exchange; ensures primacy of FIU cooperation

articles.title: Confidentiality of reporting
articles.requirement: Identity of persons filing STRs must be protected; tipping-off prohibition applies to FIU staff and recipients of FIU information

articles.title: Powers and resources of national supervisors
articles.requirement: AML/CFT supervisors must have adequate powers, staff, and resources to carry out effective risk-based supervision of obliged entities

articles.title: Supervision of forms of infrastructure of certain intermediaries operating under the freedom to provide services
articles.requirement: Rules on supervision of intermediaries providing cross-border services; coordination between home and host supervisors

articles.title: Provision of information to obliged entities
articles.requirement: Supervisors must provide obliged entities with information on ML/TF risks, typologies, and supervisory expectations to support compliance

articles.title: Risk-based supervision
articles.requirement: Supervisors must adopt risk-based approach to supervision, allocating resources proportionate to ML/TF risks; documented risk assessments of supervised entities

articles.title: Central contact points
articles.requirement: Member States may require certain cross-border obliged entities to appoint central contact points to facilitate supervision and communication

articles.title: Disclosure to FIUs
articles.requirement: Supervisors must promptly inform the FIU when they discover facts that could be related to ML/TF during their supervisory activities

articles.title: Provision of information to FIUs
articles.requirement: Supervisors must provide FIUs with information useful for FIU analysis including supervisory findings and compliance concerns

articles.title: General principles regarding supervisory cooperation
articles.requirement: AML/CFT supervisors must cooperate with each other and with AMLA; exchange relevant information regardless of nature or status of supervisory authority

articles.title: Provision of information on cross-border activities
articles.requirement: Supervisors must share information on obliged entities operating cross-border including findings from inspections and identified ML/TF risks

articles.title: Provisions related to cooperation in the context of group supervision
articles.requirement: Specific rules for supervisory cooperation regarding groups; home supervisor leads coordination; information sharing within group supervision

articles.title: Supervisory cooperation regarding obliged entities carrying out cross-border activities
articles.requirement: Detailed cooperation rules for supervision of entities with cross-border operations: joint inspections, mutual assistance, information exchange

articles.title: Exchange of information in relation to implementation of group-wide policies in third countries
articles.requirement: Supervisors exchange information on how groups implement AML/CFT policies in third-country branches and subsidiaries where local law may limit compliance

articles.title: AML/CFT supervisory colleges in the financial sector
articles.requirement: Mandatory AML/CFT colleges for cross-border financial groups posing higher ML/TF risk; lead supervisor chairs; information exchange and coordinated supervision

articles.title: AML/CFT supervisory colleges in the non-financial sector
articles.requirement: AML/CFT colleges for non-financial obliged entities operating cross-border; adapted governance rules for non-financial sector specifics

articles.title: Cooperation with supervisors in third countries
articles.requirement: AML/CFT supervisors may cooperate with third-country counterparts subject to safeguards on data protection and confidentiality

articles.title: Oversight of self-regulatory bodies
articles.section: Specific provisions relating to self-regulatory bodies
articles.requirement: Where self-regulatory bodies supervise certain professionals, Member States must ensure public authority oversight of those bodies and adequate powers and resources

articles.title: General provisions
articles.requirement: Member States must ensure supervisors can impose effective, proportionate, and dissuasive pecuniary sanctions and administrative measures for AML/CFT breaches

articles.title: Supervisory measures towards establishments of obliged entities and certain activities carried out under the freedom to provide services
articles.requirement: Specific measures supervisors may take towards cross-border establishments including restricting activities and requiring remedial action

articles.title: Pecuniary sanctions
articles.requirement: Minimum pecuniary sanction levels for serious breaches; up to EUR 10M or 10% of total annual turnover for legal persons; up to EUR 5M for natural persons

articles.title: Administrative measures
articles.requirement: Non-pecuniary administrative measures: public statements, cease-and-desist orders, withdrawal of authorisation, temporary bans on management functions

articles.title: Periodic penalty payments
articles.requirement: Supervisors may impose periodic penalty payments to compel compliance with remedial orders; calculated per day of non-compliance

articles.title: Publication of pecuniary sanctions, administrative measures and periodic penalty payments
articles.requirement: Supervisors must publish enforcement decisions including identity of entity, nature of breach, and sanction imposed; anonymisation rules for natural persons

articles.title: Exchange of information on pecuniary sanctions and administrative measures
articles.requirement: Supervisors exchange information on sanctions and measures imposed with AMLA and other relevant authorities to support coordinated enforcement

articles.title: Reporting of breaches and protection of reporting persons
articles.requirement: Member States must establish channels for reporting AML/CFT breaches; whistleblower protection in line with Directive (EU) 2019/1937

articles.title: General provisions
articles.requirement: General framework for cooperation between competent authorities across Member States on AML/CFT matters

articles.title: Communication of the list of the competent authorities
articles.requirement: Member States communicate lists of competent AML/CFT authorities to Commission and AMLA; keep updated

articles.title: Cooperation with AMLA
articles.requirement: National supervisors cooperate with AMLA; respond to AMLA requests; participate in AMLA supervisory activities

articles.title: Cooperation in relation to credit institutions or financial institutions
articles.requirement: AML/CFT supervisors cooperate with prudential supervisors of credit and financial institutions; share relevant information on ML/TF risks

articles.title: Cooperation in relation to auditors
articles.requirement: Rules on cooperation between AML/CFT supervisors and auditor oversight bodies; information sharing on AML/CFT compliance findings

articles.title: Cooperation with authorities in charge of implementing targeted financial sanctions
articles.requirement: AML/CFT supervisors cooperate with sanctions authorities to ensure coordinated approach to sanctions compliance supervision

articles.title: Professional secrecy requirements
articles.requirement: All persons involved in AML/CFT supervision bound by professional secrecy; conditions for sharing confidential information

articles.title: Exchange of information among supervisors and with other authorities
articles.requirement: Rules and safeguards for exchange of confidential information between AML/CFT supervisors and with other regulatory or law enforcement authorities

articles.title: AML/CFT cooperation guidelines
articles.requirement: AMLA issues guidelines on cooperation arrangements between national supervisors and between supervisors and other authorities

articles.title: Processing of certain categories of personal data
articles.requirement: Rules on processing special categories of personal data for AML/CFT purposes; must comply with GDPR; proportionality and necessity requirements

articles.title: Exercise of the delegation
articles.requirement: Conditions for Commission delegated acts under this Directive; delegation period; Parliament and Council revocation rights

articles.title: Committee procedure
articles.requirement: Commission assisted by Committee on Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing for implementing acts

articles.title: Transitional management of FIU.net
articles.requirement: Transitional arrangements for management of FIU.net system pending transfer to AMLA

articles.title: Amendments to Directive (EU) 2015/849
articles.requirement: Technical amendments to AMLD4 to align with the new AML/CFT framework

articles.title: Amendment to Directive (EU) 2019/1937
articles.requirement: Amendment to Whistleblower Directive to cover AML/CFT breach reporting

articles.title: Review
articles.requirement: Commission reviews application of this Directive and reports to Parliament and Council; considers effectiveness and need for amendments

articles.title: Repeal
articles.requirement: AMLD4 (Directive 2015/849) and its amendments repealed with effect from 10 July 2027

articles.title: Transposition
articles.requirement: Member States must transpose this Directive into national law by 10 July 2027

articles.title: Entry into force
articles.requirement: Directive enters into force on the twentieth day following publication in the Official Journal

articles.title: Addressees
articles.requirement: This Directive is addressed to the Member States
